card.name: Noun after a science or chemical term
card.fires_on: The word right after a biochemical or materials term (protein, DNA, steroid, molybdenum, selenide), such as fragments, solution, doses, specimens, or the start of nanocrystals. It is usually the second part of a technical noun phrase.

modes.label: Fragments, solution, doses after a substance
modes.description: A plural or generic noun follows a protein, DNA or steroid word.
